nodes.label: Dev overlay (hot reload, Vite on :5173)
nodes.rationale: Bind-mounts source for hot reload and serves Vite directly on :5173; mounts the real nginx template so the dev edge cannot drift from production (dev.conf used to be referenced here but never existed).

nodes.label: Docker socket override (DOCKER_GID group_add)
nodes.rationale: Mounting /var/run/docker.sock enables container controls and log collection for the stack host; the socket is root-equivalent, so the override is opt-in and DOCKER_GID adds the host docker group to the non-root container user.

nodes.label: Modular monolith topology (one API image, Celery worker/beat)
nodes.norm_label: modular monolith topology (one api image, celery worker/beat)
nodes.rationale: One codebase, two entrypoints (backend/app/main.py and backend/app/tasks/celery_app.py); a microservice split would add ops cost with no benefit at this scale.

nodes.label: Scheduling model (fixed beat cadences + FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claims)
nodes.norm_label: scheduling model (fixed beat cadences + for update skip locked claims)
nodes.rationale: Beat fires fixed cadences only; dynamic scheduling lives in the DB and is claimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED so overlapping ticks or extra workers partition work instead of duplicating it; beat stays dumb and restartable.

nodes.label: TLS termination via outer reverse proxy (Option A)
nodes.norm_label: tls termination via outer reverse proxy (option a)
nodes.rationale: The edge serves plain HTTP :8080 only and TLS is not wired up in the repo; run an outer HTTPS proxy that overwrites X-Forwarded-For and stamps X-Forwarded-Proto so the Secure cookie flag flips on automatically.
